lines: Jackson is listed as out for the season. He played 5 of Baltimore's 10 games, and Jacoby Brissett is the backup who starts in Week 11.
In his last 3 games he played 51% of snaps, down from 71% for the season. He averaged 13.1 PPR points a game, against 15.8 for the year.
Coach Jesse Minter said Jackson has had surgery and gave no return timeline. Our Wk 11 projection has him at 0.0 PPR points.
